reason: The iron-bearing fraction needs separating first, but no separator is visible. Inspecting the screened regolith should reveal how to proceed.
expectation: Its available partners should indicate how to separate the magnetic fraction.

effect: Screened regolith has no available operation yet, so a separator or other preparation appears necessary.
reaction: I’m curious what will enable the separation.
reason: The unconnected retort is central to making iron, and inspecting it may reveal how to prepare the installation.
expectation: Its available partners should show how to connect or prepare it.

alternatives.reason: Steel might help make the missing separator.

effect: The retort is now connected to hydrogen and ready for mineral concentrate; the magnetic fraction still needs separating.
reaction: The inspection usefully completed the retort connection, though the separator remains unclear.
reason: Steel may be used to construct the missing separator, so checking its available partners should guide the next step.
expectation: Its partners may reveal a way to make equipment for separating the iron-bearing fraction.

effect: The steel and power cable made a switchable electromagnet, providing the missing separator.
reaction: The coil’s switchable release makes the separation mechanism clear.
reason: The electromagnet should separate the magnetic iron-bearing fraction from the screened regolith.
expectation: The magnet will collect an iron-bearing concentrate for the retort.

effect: The magnet produced the iron-rich concentrate needed by the hydrogen-fed retort.
reaction: The assay distinction clarifies why red color alone is not enough to identify suitable feedstock.
reason: The connected retort is ready for the concentrate.
expectation: The heated hydrogen process will reduce the iron-bearing minerals into usable iron or an intermediate.

effect: The retort reduced the concentrate to porous iron sponge, which now needs pressing.
reaction: The weak intermediate makes clear that reduction alone does not produce a finished structural part.
reason: The result says the protected carrier brings the iron sponge to the press.
expectation: The press will consolidate the sponge into usable iron.

effect: The press consolidated the sponge into a dense iron billet, completing the iron goal; the billet still needs shaping into a frame.
reaction: The distinction between consolidation and shaping is useful.
reason: The billet needs a separate shaping operation, so inspecting it should reveal how to make the process frame.
expectation: Its available partners should show where or how to shape the frame.

alternatives.reason: The press might also shape the billet, but that operation has not been established.

effect: The press shaped the billet into bars and brackets suitable for non-pressure supports; the process frame still needs assembly.
reaction: The distinction between support parts and flight hardware is useful.
reason: The fuel-fab footing is the prepared industrial site, so the bars and brackets likely form the process frame there.
expectation: The supports will be assembled into a process frame on the prepared site.

effect: The bars and brackets became an iron process frame on the prepared footing, completing the chapter’s goals.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the local material become a support for the gas installation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reducing the concentrate and then consolidating the porous iron made the distinction between extracting metal and producing a usable billet clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the screened regolith yielded no available operation, so it did little to reveal how to make the missing separator.

surprise.text: The separator was an electromagnet made from steel and the power cable; the explanation of switching it off to release grains made the mechanism clear.

arbitrary.text: The steel-and-cable pairing was not obvious to me before inspecting steel, although the resulting coil had a clear physical purpose.

continue.text: I would continue: the material-processing steps were physically explained, and I would like to see the locally supported gas installation help bring the discovery home.
